entries.text: No beast can defeat us united!
Flee as long as you can!
Annihilon's might will crush you all!
BOW TO THE POWER OF THE RUTHLESS SEVEN!
You know what, I changed my mind. BRING IT!
You can run but you can't hide
COME HERE! FREE ITEMS FOR EVERYONE!
BOW TO THE POWER OF THE RUTHLESS SEVEN!
Slay your friends and I will spare you!
DON'T BE AFRAID!  I AM COMING IN PEACE!
I will fill MY cushion with YOUR hair! CLUCK!
ALL DRAGON SOULS BELONG TO ME!
MY RULE OVER LIFE AND DEATH WILL BE UNCHALLENGED!
BY THE ELDRITCH POWERS THAT I COMMAND - I WILL CRUSH YOU!
BEHOLD THE LAST OF THE TRUE BONELORDS!
DEATH AWAITS THOSE WHO DEFY ME!
IN THE END VICTORY WILL BE MINE NONTHELESS!
YOU PUNY CREATURES CAN'T STOP ME!
I will turn you into something more useful!
You won't rest in peace! Never ever!
Dreams can come true. As my dream of killing you.
You are no match to us!
This is where your path will end!
It's a good day to destroy!
No one will stop my ascension!
People like you are the plague and I'll be the cure!
You all will pay for not helping me!
Phew, what an awful smell ... oh, that's me.
You will suffer the same fate as I do!
I bet it was you who killed my mom!
You have been chosen for a harvest!
If you strike me down, I shall become more powerful than you could possibly imagine!
I' STILL POWERFUL ENOUGH TO CRUSH YOU!
I WILL MAKE ALL OF YOU SUFFER!
BOW TO THE POWER OF THE RUTHLESS SEVEN!
No run so much, must stay fat!
I've beaten tougher demons then you even know!
You puny humans will be my snacks!
You will get what you deserve!
Feel the power of the Mooh'Tah!
COME AND GIVE ME SOME AMUSEMENT
IS THAT THE BEST YOU HAVE TO OFFER, TIBIANS?
I AM GHAZBARAN OF THE TRIANGLE... AND I AM HERE TO CHALLENGE YOU ALL.
You are no match for me!
You can't ever be rich enough!
You can't ever be rich enough!
Witness the might of The Order of the Falcon!
T'was not me hand in your pocket!
Look! Cool stuff in house. Let's get it!
Me no steal! Me found it!
Me had it for five minutes. It's family heirloom now!
Nice human won't hurt little, good goblin?
Invite me in you lovely house plx!
Guys, help me here! Guys? Guys???
That only much dust in me pocket! Honest!
Halp, Big dumb one is after me!
Oh what fun it is to steal a one-horse open sleigh!
Must have it! Must have it!
Feel the wrath of me dos attack!
Me have a cheating link for you!
Surrender and I'll end it quick.
Your fragile bones are like toothpicks to me.
You little weasel will not live to see another day.
I'm just a messenger of what's yet to come.
I'm taking you down with me!
The powers of light are waning.
You will join us in eternal night!
The shadows will engulf the world.
THE DAY OF RECKONING IS AT HAND!
BOW TO THE POWER OF THE RUTHLESS SEVEN!
May the embrace of darkness kill you!
I'm the one and only mistress of shadows!
My daughter Nostalgia will avenge me!
I will reset this game and Tibia 1.0 will rule!
One retro version to rule them all!
One day Lord Retro will rule!
I will rope you up! All of you!
Have you seen my old pal Frack?
A MIC to rule them all!
Let me put my rope around your neck!
I have a contract here which you should sign!
I sence so much potential in you. It's almost a shame I have to kill you.
Yes, slay me for the loot I might have. Give in to your greed.
Wealth, Power, it is all at your fingertips. All you have to do is a bit blackmailing and bullying.
Come on. being a bit evil won't hurt you.
You think you have this under control?
This will be the end of you
I am a champion of darkness and you are nothing!
Death to the enemies of darkness!
I had Princess Lumelia as breakfast
My brother will come and get you for this!
My dragon is not that old, it's just second hand.
My other dragon is a red one.
When I am big I want to become the ruthless eighth.
This time the prey is you!
A prayer to the almighty one!
Feel the power of the Mooh'Tah!
I AM MORGAROTH, LORD OF THE TRIANGLE... AND YOU ARE LOST!
MY SEED IS FEAR AND MY HARVEST ARE YOUR SOULS!
ZATHROTH! LOOK AT THE DESTRUCTION I AM CAUSING IN YOUR NAME!
THE TRIANGLE OF TERROR WILL RISE!
You will make a fine trophy.
Let me hear the music of battle.
Another one to bite the dust!
You are starting to annoy me!
I will restore our family honor!
I'm the hunter and you are my prey!
Take that creature off my back!! I can feel it!
You will regret interrupting my studies!
You will be the next infected one... CRAAAHHH!
Run as fast as you can.
Oh by the gods! What is this... aaaaaargh!
Close your eyes... I want to show you something.
I've been in the shadow under your bed last night.
You never know what hides in the night.
I remember your face - and I know where you sleep.
Only the sweetest and cruelest dreams for you, my love.
PRAISED BE MY MASTERS, THE RUTHLESS SEVEN!
Be prepared for the day my masters will come for you!
Oh my, you forgot to put your pants on!
Dream a little dream with me!
Oh my, you forgot to put your pants on!
Dream a little dream with me!
I CAN SENSE YOUR BODY ROTTING!
You are looking a bit feverish!
YOUR FUTILE ATTACKS ONLY FEED MY RAGE!
I WILL FEAST ON YOUR SOUL!
FEEL THE TRUE MEANING OF VANQUISH!
HAHAHAHA DO YOU WANT TO AMUSE YOUR MASTER?
YOU HAVE BAD BREATH, TAKE A MINT!!!
Terofar cast a greater death curse on you!
IT TOOK AN ARMY OF YOUR KIND TO DEFEAT THE WARDEN. NOW YOU ARE ALONE!
THE WARDS ARE FAILING! MY ESCAPE IS ONLY A MATTER OF TIME!!
FEELS GOOD TO BE BACK IN ACTION!
I will eat you in your sleep.
I am the darkness around you...
You will be mine for eternity!
I will end your torment. Do not run, little mortal.
*SNIFF* *SNIFF* BLOOD! I CAN SMELL YOU, MORTAL!!
Let me tickle you with my trident!
I'll crush you beneath my feet!
The Scourge Of Oblivion prepares a devestating attack!
The Scourge Of Oblivion activates its reflective shields!
You will fall before our might!
Close your eyes... I have something for you.
You can't run or hide forever!
I'm the executioner of the Seven!
The judgement is guilty! The sentence is death!
I call you, my bats! Come!
Don't struggle. We don't want to waste a drop of blood now, do we?
Come my maidens, we have visitors!
If music is the food of death, drop dead.
BOW TO THE POWER OF THE RUTHLESS SEVEN!
An enemy of the worm shall become his food!
The great worm will swallow you!
From the earthy depths he comes and brings freedom!
I AM ZORALURK, THE DEMON WITH A THOUSAND FACES
